global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, dark broth with tender chashu, crisp menma, and a soft naruto fish cake, all topped with vibrant green onions. Served in a white ceramic bowl, the dish gleams under warm, ambient lighting on a dark wooden table.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections, forming an oval shape around the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with glossy finish, smooth surface, and printed red Japanese characters on its rim.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, green onions, chashu pork, and bamboo shoots, rich brown liquid with visible strands and toppings.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is round, browned, and glazed, with a slightly crispy texture and visible fat marbling.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, glossy, and slightly curved with visible fibrous texture and faint greenish hue.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pale pink, translucent, flower-shaped with glossy surface and single green garnish on top.
